name: OmaTube
author: Aaron Shahriari
description: Your YouTube playlists in the bar — open one, play a video in mpv or the browser, drop it from the list without leaving the desktop

barWidget.description: Playlists, and the videos inside them, one click from the bar

schema.label: Play videos with
schema.description: mpv streams through yt-dlp with no browser and no ads. Browser hands the watch URL to your default handler. Custom runs the command below.

schema.label: Custom player command
schema.description: Used only when the player is Custom. {url} becomes the watch URL and {id} the video id — e.g. `freetube {url}`. Without a placeholder the URL is appended.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Icon shows the glyph alone. Playlists shows how many you have. Videos shows the total across every playlist.

schema.label: Max videos listed
schema.description: Per playlist, in the bar popup. The fullscreen view always shows everything.

schema.label: Confirm before removing
schema.description: Off makes removal one click, undoable for a few seconds from the row it left behind.

schema.label: Background sync
schema.description: How often the playlist list refreshes on its own. Opening the panel always syncs, so this only governs the idle case.
